translation_status: English draft export; current insertion and review status tracked separately in docs/translation-status.json

rows.en: Reamond: "...Come in."
Miyasco: "..."
Reamond: "What's the matter? There's no one else here."
Miyasco: "I-is that so...? Good."
Miyasco: "..."
Reamond: "U-um...? There's no need to lock the door..."
Reamond: "I-I really don't think this is a good idea...
Besides, I-I've already given my heart to a woman... No, I don't mean
that you aren't attractive or anything..."
Miyasco: "...Please look at this."
Reamond: "?! Th-that's..."
Miyasco: "'Code 3.' The brand that never fades,
burned into the subjects of that loathsome experiment..."
Reamond: "I see... You're the only one who was still missing...
It's a wonder you're alive."
Miyasco: "Yes. Major Rest of Agarthia saved me."
Reamond: "The Phoenix Knight...? You were lucky.
So, how are you? Physically, I mean."
Miyasco: "As long as I don't get into that device,
I have almost no problems... Though
it took time to break the mental binding."
Reamond: "So 'love for the Major' triumphed?"
Miyasco: "Wh-what?! D-don't tease me!
Anyway, that medicine you had earlier was a tranquilizer, wasn't it?
A particularly powerful one..."
Reamond: "Well, I'm impressed.
You could tell all that at a glance...
Why not open a practice?"
Miyasco: "Stop joking. If you keep taking that stuff,
your body won't hold out."
Reamond: "I'm glad you're worried about me,
but this body reached its limit long ago.
Well, at best, I've got a few months left."
Miyasco: "No... Even now, you could..."
Reamond: "No. Someone like me shouldn't exist.
You're all right as long as you don't get into that thing,
but I'm no longer an ordinary human.
Still, I need this body to work a little longer.
I have to stop that plan..."
Miyasco: "Is Prince Cain involved in it too?"
Reamond: "...No. He was merely cooperating.
The mastermind is President Horem. He restarted
'Code 3,' the project that made us this way.
And this time, he's using a much simpler method."
Miyasco: "What could that be...?"
Reamond: "It's..."
Fores: "What's wrong, Lieutenant?! Has something happened?!"
Reamond: "Everything's fine. I'll open the door now."
Fores: "What on earth... You are...?"
Miyasco: "Oh, h-hello..."
Fores: "..."
Reamond: "N-no... Um, even if you look at me like that...
We weren't..."
Fores: "We? Y-you... You..."
Reamond: "No, as I was saying... Ahaa."
Fores: "Wh-what is that triumphant look for?!"
Reamond: "I see... Well, if you're jealous,
I can take that as a sign I have a chance, can't I?
Really, you should have told me sooner..."
Fores: "Wh-who's jealous?! Stop talking nonsense
and come along! We're leaving!"
Reamond: "Oh, w-wait a moment..."
Miyasco: "Reamond..."
Reamond: "...Don't worry. I'll stop it.
Even if it costs me my life..."
Fores: "What are you whispering about?!"
Reamond: "N-nothing! ...See you."
Miyasco: "Reamond..."
Fores: "We will take our leave, then.
Thank you for your cooperation."
Reamond: "Likewise..."
Ymir: "Oh? Your swollen cheek..."
Reamond: "Oh, don't worry about it.
Just a little lovers' quarrel."
Ymir: "I-I see..."
Fores: "We're going!"
Reamond: "Oh, wait, Colonel!"
Miyasco: (Reamond...)
Sisk: "Both Griol units have been launched."
Ymir: "For now, that should..."
Sisk: "Huh? This is the private line...
Could it be His Highness?!"
Ymir: "Put it on the monitor, please."
Sisk: "Understood!"
Maki: "Hey there!"
Sisk: "..."
Maki: "Hey! What's with that utterly disappointed face?
First Fain the other day, and now you...
Honestly, how rude!"
Fain: "Maki, why are you using
His Majesty's private line?"
Maki: "Geh... A-ahem! What are you talking about?
For someone like me, that's a piece of cake!
It's the easiest thing in the world!"
Touya: "Why are you so flustered?"
Maki: "N-never mind that. You stopped it safely. I'm impressed.
I knew you could do it. ...And while I wouldn't exactly call it thanks,
I have two interesting bits of information. Want to hear them?"
Touya: "Stop building it up and tell us already."
Maki: "All right, all right. First...
A full-scale liberation movement has begun in York.
Mercenaries and knights from all over are gathering one after another,
so liberation from Zigrim is only a matter of time.
Incidentally, I'm told the leader isn't 'Sword Radiance'
Garyud Via Vratzen,
but his daughter, Ciel Ren Vratzen."
Fain: "Oh! Lord Garyud has risen to the cause!
Then York is as good as liberated!"
Touya: "I see... We couldn't do anything, but I'm glad."
Arthur: "What is the second piece of information?"
Maki: "Prepare to be amazed. I've found
Prince Tix's whereabouts!"
Celica: "!! I-is that true?! Where?!
Where is he?!"
Maki: "At an estate upstream on the Hoelai River,
near the Zigrim-York border. Incidentally, downstream
is Cornel Village, famous for its hot springs."
Celica: "Is Tix... Is Tix safe?!"
Maki: "Hmm. Apparently, Cornel Village recently began receiving requests
to deliver food and everyday supplies to the estate,
so I think he should be all right..."
Celica: "You think?! How can you be so irresponsible?!"
Touya: "Calm down. Cain wants to use Tix
to control Agarthia, right?
Then he's unlikely to hurt him. It'll be all right."
Celica: "...Y-you're right...
S-sorry. I lost my composure..."
Maki: "Anyway, I'll send the coordinates, the estate's floor plan,
the data I've gathered and everything else."
Celica: "Thank you."
Maki: "I'm honored to be of service. Oh, right.
Have you heard how the war between Agarthia and Zigrim is going?"
Celica: "No... Is it going badly?"
Maki: "Rather the opposite. But General Growster
has taken the field, so it's possible
he and His Majesty Lodis will face off as the two commanders."
Celica: "So the front is at a stalemate?"
Maki: "Yes. Neither army wants a war of attrition, I'm sure.
Well, I'll be going, then.
There's something I need to investigate..."
Fain: "What are you scheming this time?"
Maki: "How rude! I'm doing it for you, you know?"
Touya: "For us?"
Maki: "I can't say any more just yet.
I think I'll be able to tell you before long.
Just look forward to it!"
Fain: "Maki, don't push yourself too hard.
I know you're willing to risk your life for a story, but..."
Maki: "Yes, yes. Fain, you're such
a widdle worrywart, aren't you?"
Fain: "Take this seriously!"
Maki: "I'll be fine. Well, see you later!"
Maki: "...Was that all right?"
Lodis: "Yes. They will surely rescue Tix.
As things stand, he will only be used.
Even if he must dirty his own hands,
it must not be because someone forced him to do so.
Not until Tix chooses to act of his own free will.
Though, of course, an unblemished ruler would be better still."
Maki: "Your Highness..."
Lodis: "More importantly, you mustn't
push yourself too hard either. Your body
is no longer yours alone, after all."
Maki: "?! H-how did you know that...?"
Lodis: "Heh heh heh. One of my twelve special talents."
Maki: "I-I see..."
Ai: "Hmm, so this is the estate.
It's one of those three-dimensional images, right? Pretty handy."
Touya: "This isn't the time to be impressed.
Anyway, is this place built on top of a cliff?"
Ymir: "Yes. For some reason, everyone seems to want to build
right on the edge of cliffs like that. It's strange, isn't it?"
Baren: "Shall we maintain our present course?"
Ymir: "Yes, plea..."
Celica: "Hold on a moment!"
Ymir: "Huh? What's wrong?"
Celica: "The name this estate is registered under...
is Ricara Zea Isfandeil."
Fain: "Isfandeil...? Limberg's royal family?"
Celica: "Ricara was the principal consort.
Cain's mother."
Clovis: "Something smells fishy..."
Arthur: "It is possible he deliberately chose somewhere
we would find, but it is rather too blatant."
Touya: "Are you saying it's a trap?"
Ymir: "That is quite likely.
In the worst case, if he uses Prince Tix as a shield,
we won't be able to act."
Arthur: "Surely he has considered the possibility
that we would come to rescue him aboard the Liebhofen.
Approaching carelessly would be dangerous."
Touya: "Then what do we do?"
Xiujian: "He probably does not intend to kill Prince Tix.
But would he sacrifice his own life to keep the Prince alive?
That is unlikely.
Therefore, the rescue must be carried out in absolute secrecy.
Infiltrating on foot would be most effective,
but the problem is how.
Clovis, Arthur and I are one thing,
but the others are not suited to that sort of work.
A clumsy entry would have little chance of success.
The same goes for entering from the cliff."
Fain: "Then all that's left... is to go in fair and square!"
Ai: "Are you stupid? Obviously we can't do that."
Fain: "What did you say?!"
Kasumi: "Now, now. Ai, Fain..."
Fain: "Yes. I understand.
Hmph! You ought to take
a lesson from Kasumi."
Ai: "You're so annoying! Why the different attitude?!"
Touya: "You two, knock it off already."
Ai & Fain: "What?!"
Clovis: "...You're perfectly in sync when it comes to that."
Yamato: "Oh! Hey, didn't Maki say they were delivering food
from the village downstream?"
Celica: "That's it! Whatever he was like before, Cain
wouldn't negotiate or receive deliveries himself now.
We'll use that! Good thinking, Yamato!"
Yamato: "Ahem!"
Arthur: "I see. That is another option."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Arthur: "The wealthy do not do their own shopping.
They make others come to them.
To flaunt their wealth and power, and satisfy themselves.
We will take advantage of that by replacing the food delivery workers
in Cornel Village and entering the estate with the supplies."
Touya: "I see. Hm? Wait. Even if Cain
doesn't come out himself, a servant or someone will take the delivery, right?
Won't they get suspicious if unfamiliar people come along?"
Clovis: "Then we'll gather information in Cornel Village.
I've got a good idea. Leave it to me."
Aurelie: "...That makes me really nervous."
Clovis: "I had Bart get this for me
in case something like this happened. At last, its moment has come..."
Touya: "What's that huge bag?"
Clovis: "Heh heh... A secret weapon."
Ymir: "Anyway, let's head for Cornel Village.
For now, remain on standby until we arrive."
Touya: "...I'm kind of bored..."
Yamato: "No. We were told to stay on standby, remember?"
Touya: "...A little walk won't hurt, right?
Sitting still doesn't suit me."
Yamato: "Honestly, what am I going to do with you...?
But don't wander around too much."
Touya: "I know, I know."
Yamato: "Then I'll come too... Hm?"
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Yamato: "W-well... What is this?
Something's wrong with my sensor..."
Touya: "Sensor?
That personal sensor thing you mentioned?"
Yamato: "Yeah... Oh, it seems to be working nyow.
Yes, it's all right."
Touya: "Want to have Gabon take a look at it?"
Yamato: "No, thanks. This time he'd probably add some weird function."
Touya: "...You've got a point.
But are you really all right?"
Yamato: "Yeah."
Touya: "All right. Then let's go for a little walk."
Yamato: "Yes!"

review_batches.context: Full 260-row member examined: Miyasco/Reamond Code 3 conversation, Fores misunderstanding, Maki/Lodis information and Tix estate rescue planning, Yamato sensor episode. First slice covers Code 3 and departure.
review_batches.decisions: Keep the adult misunderstanding distinct from what actually occurs, indelible brand, Rest rescue, device-dependent condition and mental binding. Reamond reports his own few-month prognosis and Horem's restart; do not turn these into narrator-certified medicine or fill the interrupted method explanation. Fores is female and a lieutenant colonel; shortened Colonel address is not a promotion. Preserve sworn resolve without narrating death.

row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00061.l00: Come in reads the invitation in the room/locked-door context. No offer of medicine or drink is supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00128.l01: Reamond says he has already chosen a woman. The scene establishes an adult misunderstanding, not an actual romantic act between him and Miyasco.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o001ec.l00: Code 3 brand and its permanence are explicit; do not add the exact location here from another profile or a newly invented number.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0026e.l00: Major Rest rescued Miyasco. Preserve the rank and Phoenix Knight reference without confusing Rest with the similarly named Reamond.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o002d1.l00: Almost no problems is conditional on not entering that device. Do not claim she has no lasting effects under every condition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o002d1.l02: Mental binding was broken over time. Mechanism is unspecified; no invented medical or supernatural procedure.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0034f.l01: Tranquilizer strength is Miyasco's observation. No real-world product, dose or treatment advice is added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0039e.l02: Opening a practice is Reamond's teasing praise, not evidence Miyasco has a licensed clinic.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0040e.l02: At best a few months is Reamond's own estimate; do not turn it into an objective diagnosis or confirmed death.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00477.l00: Someone like me should not exist is Reamond's self-judgment. Preserve his despair without making it the narrator's moral stance.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0052e.l00: Cain's cooperation is distinguished from Horem being the mastermind, as Reamond reports. Do not substitute a denial that Cain was involved at all.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0052e.l03: Simpler method is reported but not explained before interruption; do not import a mechanism from later source.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o006f5.l00: Fores reacts to the word we. Keep the repeated word/unfinished rebuke rather than an invented explicit accusation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00760.l00: Reamond interprets her reaction as jealousy and a romantic chance; Fores denies it. Neither reaction is narration establishing a relationship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00828.l00: Reamond vows to stop the plan even at cost of life. This is a future conditional resolve, not a narrated death or request for Miyasco to risk herself.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00977.l00: Swollen cheek is observed. Do not invent the blow itself or a weapon.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00a33.l00: Exactly both Griol units have launched; no third mech or destination is added.

review_batches.context: Maki uses the royal private channel, reports York liberation leadership/Tix location and speaks privately with Lodis. Entire member read before drafting.
review_batches.decisions: Keep two pieces of intelligence, Garyud Via/Ciel Ren Vratzen distinction, Fain's overexcited response, inferred safety rather than witnessed rescue, Hoelai upstream versus Cornel downstream, and qualified front-line report. Lodis wants Tix's free choice rather than enforced dirty work. Highness and Majesty remain as individually spoken; no title normalization across source slips.

row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00a7a.l01: Sisk still says Highness after the coronation. Fain says Majesty at 89-90; preserve both source addresses rather than silently correcting Sisk.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00be2.l02: Exactly two information items; first York, second Tix.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00c63.p02.l00: Maki explicitly says the leader is not Garyud but his daughter Ciel. Fain's next reaction focuses on Garyud anyway; do not rewrite it to repair his listening.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00d67.l00: Touya says the party could do nothing in this route. Do not force this into the alternate earlier York-liberation chronology.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00e10.l00: Estate upstream on Hoelai River, Cornel Village downstream. Keep orientation and border context; no unprinted coordinates invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00e90.l00: Supplies delivered to the estate support Maki's belief Tix is safe; she does not claim she has personally seen him.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00f17.l00: Touya reasons Cain wants to use Tix to control Agarthia, so harm is unlikely. It is reassurance/inference, not proof of absolute safety.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o00faa.l00: Maki will send coordinates, floor plan and gathered data. No actual numeric coordinates appear in these dialogue rows.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0105a.l00: Situation is relatively favorable, but Growster's presence may lead to a commanders' confrontation. No completed duel or outcome supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o011fb.l01: Deliberate baby-talk widdle matches Maki teasing Fain's concern; do not attribute a real speech impairment.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o012b9.l00: Lodis believes the party will rescue Tix. He supplied the private line/info through Maki; no invented direct order to kidnap the prince.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o012b9.p01.l00: Dirtying one's hands must be Tix's own choice rather than coercion. Preserve the morally compromised possibility and the wish for an unblemished ruler.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01368.l00: Maki says Highness despite his accession. Preserve the spoken term as with Sisk, not an inferred reversal of the coronation.

review_batches.context: Lodis's health hint to Maki, twelve talents, estate registration, trap/hostage analysis and food-delivery infiltration proposal. All 260 rows examined, including Yamato's later sensor issue.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve the body-no-longer-yours-alone hint without explicit parentage or new medical details. Ricara Zea Isfandeil is Cain's mother and former principal consort; do not assume death or a queenly title. Cain's likely intent versus willingness to risk his life are distinct. Keep uncertain tactical estimates, coordinated Ai/Fain retort and the unconfirmed secret weapon.

row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0137c.l01: Body no longer yours alone is the source hint. Do not add a stated pregnancy, father identity or medical detail that the dialogue leaves implicit.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o013df.l00: Exactly twelve special talents, delivered jokingly. Do not turn it into a verified gameplay ability list.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01577.l01: Full estate registration name Ricara Zea Isfandeil is editorial spelling following Cain's existing surname; she is explicitly his mother.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o015da.l00: Former principal consort does not prove death, remarriage or a queen's formal title in a principality.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0161d.l00: Deliberate choice of a discoverable location is possible but suspiciously blatant. Keep Arthur's qualification rather than announcing a proved trap.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0172c.l00: In 192-194, doing so is read as keeping Tix alive even at cost of Cain's own life, because the surrounding discussion warns that an open assault risks using Tix as a shield. Cain not intending murder is not a safety guarantee. Flag this inferred antecedent for independent meaning review.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0172c.l06: Xiujian exempts himself, Clovis and Arthur from the lack-of-infiltration-skill concern. Do not reverse the exception or include them among the unfit.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o018ab.l01: Boiling and drinking Kasumi's nail dirt is an idiom for learning from her example. Keep the contempt through take a lesson, not a literal hygiene instruction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01925.l00: Both Ai and Fain speak the same retort. Preserve combined speaker label and one row.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o0199f.l00: Celica says Cain would not personally handle the delivery now, whatever the past. Do not infer a named servant or guaranteed unguarded route.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01a45.l02: Wealth/power display and self-satisfaction are Arthur's social judgment, not a guaranteed rule for every wealthy person.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01adc.l02: Touya raises unfamiliar-face risk; the plan is not yet proved successful.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01b96.l00: Bart procured an item in the large bag. Clovis calls it a secret weapon, but no content is named here.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01cce.l00: Standby remains the actual order; Yamato's reminder is not a new command from the captain.

review_batches.context: Last twenty rows: Touya's impatience, Yamato's personal sensor concern, apparent recovery and proposed walk. Full member read for context.
review_batches.decisions: Keep standby as the actual order, the small walk as Touya's request, Yamato's tentative sensor recovery and her refusal of Gabon's potential tinkering. No diagnosed malfunction cause, new installed function or specific detection range is invented. Actual end-of-member slice.

row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01da1.l01: Sensor trouble is Yamato's perception, apparently clearing at 251. No outside diagnosis or newly discovered enemy is supplied.
row_decisions.scenario.s_014.o01e43.l00: She fears Gabon would add a weird function. Do not narrate that he has already modified it again.
